What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
The vertex of a downward-opening parabola is the highest point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13955030/assets/9e73d4e1d8cc8a61fffeab716359b29b31176f9669eff852d9d7817ccd4e8ef5.png)

  

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(-4,-4).$
